question: A fair 6-sided die is rolled.  If I roll $n$, then I win $n^2$ dollars.  What is the expected value of my win?  Express your answer as a dollar value rounded to the nearest cent.
solution:
Each roll from 1 through 6 has probability 1/6, so the expected win is the average of the six squared outcomes. In dollars, this is (1 + 4 + 9 + 16 + 25 + 36)/6 = 91/6 = 15.1666…, which rounds to 15.17 to the nearest cent.
Final answer: \$15.17
